headline: US Plans $57.4 Million in Tentative Awards for Meat Processors
summary: Washington plans $57.4 million in tentative awards for US meat processors, pending congressional approval, as the domestic cattle herd sits at a 75-year low.
why: Agricultural subsidies and supply chain support impact livestock producers, food inflation, and profit margins for major food processing conglomerates.

impacts.name: US Agriculture and Meat Processing
impacts.why: Federal funding injections provide financial support to meat processors grappling with multi-decade low cattle inventories.
